text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text: So this is what charms people so… The suspense of the game makes the prize exciting in a way simply buying a toy doesn't.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text: I must also say, Trainer, you showed a surgical level of skill operating the claw. I shall give this plush pride of place in my room.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text: Hehe. I can hardly wait to look upon it with Chiyono O.
